verification_scope_reason: Actual Session/projection/Cordis effects pair lazy mixed-input ordering, single consumer, captured failures, self-closing transforms, readiness before existence, creation-prefix replay/cursor deduplication, explicit gap refusal, external-buffer ownership, per-event grouped projection changes, cancellation discarding queued frames and provider unload waking a reader without queries. Native adds partial registration/effect failures, transform failure identity, mid-batch listener disposal, consumer task cancellation and actual Gateway resource admission/cancellation for the new Remote methods. History/access direct consumers and the matching Source listener suites pass.
implementation: ListenerBuffer owns registrations and lifetime, transforms notifications lazily and admits one consumer. EventListener fills only uncovered creation/live prefixes and fails gaps. ProjectionListener emits one grouped change frame per committed event without requiring contiguous projection seqs. Candidate History reads and Remote faces expose observeEvent and observeProjections.
observer_boundary: Committed event timestamps normalize to zero. External creation/gap cases use explicit notification replay over actual Session data. Native fault injection uses controlled registration failures. Assistant-stream reconnect state, composite state/wait/follow and complete controller initialization remain separate. The earlier progress commentary said 19 observations; the actual report contains 18. These targeted results do not establish full regression or release acceptance.
